# Exam Compass API Documentation for LLMs

## Overview
Exam Compass is an AI-powered exam preparation platform for JEE, NEET, and UPSC.

## Core Routes
- /: Home Page
- /login: User Login
- /dashboard: Private User Dashboard (Auth Required)

## Public Resources
- /jee-mains: JEE Mains Exam Guide
- /neet: NEET Exam Guide
